# Purpose

Fast **manual** smoke of public APIs used by the vignettes and by the
JCGS array/GLAM path. Not registered as a vignette (avoids R CMD check cost).

```bash
cd path/to/ttpsplines-pkg
Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("tests/manual/smoke_test_apis.Rmd")'
```

Or knit from RStudio after `devtools::load_all()`.

# Vignette map (review)

| Vignette | Focus | Notes |
|----------|--------|------|
| `getting-started` | Ishigami / Sobol / Friedman | Points to `array-mode` for grids |
| `array-mode` | `ttps(..., array = TRUE)` | Product grids, parity, cGCV, Poisson note |
| `generalized` | Poisson / Bernoulli; `linear=` / `smooth=` | Grids → `array-mode` / `glam-poisson` |
| `cgcv` | fixed / cGCV / CV / gGCV | gGCV = Gaussian scattered only |
| `rank-selection` | `tt_rank_select` | OK |
| `aic-bic` | linearized AIC/BIC | OK |
| `glam-vs-tt` | `compare_glam_tt_gaussian` | Dense GLAM vs TT (not `array=TRUE` path) |
| `glam-poisson` | `glam_fit_poisson` | Dense Poisson GLAM |
| `scalability` | storage / backends | OK |
| `uncertainty` | SEs / intervals | OK |
| `margin-activity-path` | margin screening | OK |

Last automated knit (`vignettes/_build_check.csv`): rebuild after adding `array-mode`.

Array-mode smoke chunks below remain the fast regression check for K-ALS.

```{r lib}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  if (requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE) &&
      file.exists("../../DESCRIPTION")) {
    ## knit from tests/manual/
    tryCatch(
      devtools::load_all("../..", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) library(TTPsplines)
    )
  } else {
    library(TTPsplines)
  }
})
ctrl <- function(...) {
  dots <- list(...)
  base <- list(
    max_sweeps = 4L, compute_edf = FALSE, seed = 1L, trace = FALSE,
    als_sweeps_adaptive = FALSE
  )
  do.call(tt_control, utils::modifyList(base, dots))
}
pass <- function(ok, msg) {
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg, call. = FALSE)
  cat("PASS:", msg, "\n")
}
```

# 1. Scattered Gaussian + predict

```{r scattered-gaussian}
set.seed(1)
n <- 120L
X <- matrix(runif(n * 3), n, 3)
f <- sin(pi * X[, 1]) * cos(pi * X[, 2]) + 0.3 * X[, 3]
y <- f + rnorm(n, sd = 0.2)
fit_g <- ttps(y, X, rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 1,
              control = ctrl())
pass(inherits(fit_g, "ttpspline"), "scattered Gaussian returns ttpspline")
pass(identical(fit_g$optimizer_used, "ALS") ||
       identical(fit_g$optimizer, "ALS") ||
       !is.null(fit_g$eta),
     "Gaussian fit has eta / ALS path")
pr <- predict(fit_g, X[1:5, ], type = "link")
pass(length(pr) == 5L && all(is.finite(pr)), "predict link finite")
```

# 2. Array mode (K-ALS) vs scattered parity

Tiny product grid; fixed \(\lambda\); few sweeps — fitted values should match.

```{r array-parity}
set.seed(2)
ng <- c(8L, 7L, 6L)
axes <- list(
  x1 = seq(0, 1, length.out = ng[1]),
  x2 = seq(0, 1, length.out = ng[2]),
  x3 = seq(0, 1, length.out = ng[3])
)
truth <- outer(
  outer(sin(2 * pi * axes$x1), cos(2 * pi * axes$x2), "+"),
  axes$x3, function(a, b) a + 0.5 * b
)
Y <- truth + array(rnorm(prod(ng), 0, 0.15), dim = ng)
idx <- expand.grid(lapply(ng, seq_len), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE)
Xg <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_along(ng), function(j) axes[[j]][idx[[j]]]))
yg <- as.numeric(Y)

c1 <- ctrl(max_sweeps = 1L)  # one sweep: Gram paths agree tightly
fit_sc <- ttps(yg, Xg, rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 1, control = c1)
fit_ar <- ttps(Y, axes = axes, array = TRUE, rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 1,
               control = c1)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((fit_ar$fitted.values - fit_sc$fitted.values)^2))
pass(is.finite(rmse) && rmse < 1e-8,
     sprintf("array vs scattered RMSE = %.3e (< 1e-8)", rmse))
pass(!is.null(fit_ar$backend) || TRUE,
     "array fit completed")
```

# 3. Poisson + binomial (family auto)

```{r glm-families}
set.seed(3)
eta <- f - mean(f)
yp <- rpois(n, exp(eta + log(2)))
fit_p <- ttps(yp, X, family = poisson(), rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 1,
              control = ctrl(pirls_maxit = 12L))
pass(all(is.finite(fit_p$fitted.values)), "Poisson fitted finite")
pass(grepl("PIRLS|ALS", paste(fit_p$optimizer_used, fit_p$optimizer),
           ignore.case = TRUE) || all(is.finite(fit_p$eta)),
     "Poisson path ran")

yb <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(1.2 * scale(eta)[, 1]))
fit_b <- ttps(yb, X, family = binomial(), rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 5,
              control = ctrl(lbfgs_maxit = 40L))
pb <- predict(fit_b, X[1:3, ], type = "response")
pass(all(pb >= 0 & pb <= 1), "Bernoulli response in [0,1]")
```

# 4. cGCV (one short fit)

```{r cgcv}
fit_c <- ttps(y, X, rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = "cGCV",
              control = ctrl(max_sweeps = 6L))
pass(length(fit_c$lambda) == 3L && all(is.finite(fit_c$lambda)),
     "cGCV returns length-d finite lambda")
pass(identical(fit_c$lambda_method, "cGCV") ||
       grepl("cGCV", paste(fit_c$lambda_method), ignore.case = TRUE),
     "lambda_method records cGCV")
```

# 5. Packaged data + summary

```{r packaged}
data(ishigami, package = "TTPsplines")
Xi <- as.matrix(ishigami[seq_len(200), c("x1", "x2", "x3")])
yi <- ishigami$y[seq_len(200)]
fit_i <- ttps(yi, Xi, rank = 2L, k = 5L, lambda = 1, control = ctrl())
s <- summary(fit_i)
pass(!is.null(s), "summary(ttpspline) works")
tc <- tryCatch(tt_complexity(fit_i), error = function(e) NULL)
pass(!is.null(tc), "tt_complexity works")
```

# 6. Optional: gGCV API smoke (skip if slow)

Joint gGCV is expensive; keep budgets tiny. Set `SMOKE_GGCV=1` to enable.

```{r ggcv, eval = identical(Sys.getenv("SMOKE_GGCV"), "1")}
fit_gg <- ttps(
  y, X, rank = 2L, k = 4L, lambda = "gGCV",
  control = ctrl(
    max_sweeps = 3L,
    ggcv_max_evals = 8L
  )
)
pass(all(is.finite(fit_gg$lambda)), "gGCV returns finite lambda")
```

# Checklist

```{r summary-table}
elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t_doc
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  check = c(
    "scattered Gaussian + predict",
    "array vs scattered parity",
    "Poisson + binomial",
    "cGCV",
    "ishigami + summary/complexity",
    sprintf("wall time (s) ≈ %.1f", elapsed)
  ),
  status = "PASS"
))
```

If any chunk stops with `PASS:` missing, fix that API before releasing vignettes.
